baseline.status: proposed by the Harness; Obelisco states "AA-AAA" without saying which AAA

aaa_additional.source: normativa/extractos/Obelisco.md, checklist de accesibilidad, bloque 4 (el indicador de foco con un mínimo de 3:1)
aaa_additional.note: A 3:1 focus indicator is already required at AA by 1.4.11 when the author styles it; 2.4.13 adds a minimum size and a change-of-contrast rule.

aaa_additional.source: normativa/extractos/Obelisco.md, checklist de accesibilidad, bloque 3 (legibilidad del contenido)
aaa_additional.note: Reading level is a content judgement, not a markup property.
The page cites it without stating a level.

discrepancies: Obelisco's checklist asks for WCAG 2.2 "AA-AAA" and defines no AAA set: the Harness reads it as AA plus the AAA criteria Obelisco names (`aaa_additional`).
Obelisco's component pages link most criteria to WCAG 2.1 Understanding pages; the criteria and levels they state are the same in 2.2.
The adoption guide checklist cites 1.4.2 Audio Control for "media that autoplay can be paused or stopped"; pausing moving content is 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide (Level A).

Obelisco's pages for several components (validation, tabs, tooltip, collapsible, carousel, switch, horizontal and vertical navigation, steps) publish an Accessibility tab without content at the consultation date.

requirements.text: Form fields always have a visible `Label` that a screen reader can read.

requirements.quote_es: Si la sesión expira, la persona usuaria debe poder reautenticarse y continuar desde donde estaba, sin pérdida de datos.

requirements.text: A content-imposed time limit, a session timeout included, can be turned off, adjusted or extended, unless an exception applies.

notes: The page names "Labels or Instructions" without its number: it is 3.3.2.
The page cites technique G98 (review and confirm before submitting).

requirements.text: Role or native element, accessible name and states are designed explicitly, not inherited from a look-alike.
A keyboard model is written down: keys, order, how to leave the component.
A focus model is written down: where focus goes on open, close and error, and a visible indicator of at least 3:1.
Dynamic updates are announced without moving focus.
Text and UI contrast, target size and reflow are measured in a browser, not assumed.
